meta.$comment: Documents the React clone in this folder. Only the French homepage of https://laboiteaslides.fr/ is cloned; every other href (expertises, réalisations, contact, legal…) points at the original site's routes and is NOT built here. Section order measured at 1440x900 (CLONE_SPEC_A.md / CLONE_SPEC_B.md); y-offsets in descriptions are scroll px at that viewport.
meta.source: https://laboiteaslides.fr/ (FR homepage) → clone at /src (React + Vite + Tailwind v3, three r181, GSAP, Lenis)
meta.status: measured-from-live-site; bottom-half sections still in build

categories.CHROME: Site-wide fixed or overlay UI that is not part of the scrolling story: header bar, loader, menu overlay, modal, footer.
categories.BACKDROP: The fixed full-screen WebGL canvas behind the page that draws backgrounds, glass triangles, 3D titles and the VR scene.
categories.HERO: The opening scroll-driven statement of the page.
categories.STORY: Pinned (sticky) scroll-scrubbed narrative blocks whose content animates with scroll progress.
categories.PROOF: Evidence blocks: case studies, credentials, metrics, testimonials.
categories.OFFER: Blocks describing what the agency sells.
categories.CONTENT: Editorial and help content: resources, FAQ.

backdrop.webgl-scene.description: Fixed canvas#SYNTHRA (z-index -1): gradient background shader with 10 domed colour layers, RGB-shift post pass, 22 glass triangles (intro checkerboard, frame, fence, pinwheel), clipped 3D FKScreamer titles, camera keyframes, VR headset GLB and 80-tile thumbnail sphere. Also computes the header light/dark state.
backdrop.webgl-scene.scope: Present on the one homepage route, behind every other section; on mobile only a static white-to-grey gradient is drawn.

chrome.header.description: Fixed 12rem header bar: logo link, centred 'Menu/Fermer' glass trigger with clip-path text swap, 'Demander un devis' CTA; switches between light and dark designs from the backdrop colour.
chrome.header.scope: Fixed at the top of the one homepage route for its full length.

chrome.loader.description: Purple three-layer-mask loader panel with a two-triangle spinner; lifts on load (triggers the 3D intro) and closes behind the menu when it opens.
chrome.loader.scope: Shown once on first load of the homepage route and reused as the purple frame behind the menu overlay.

chrome.menu-overlay.description: White rounded panel opened from the header trigger with a 3D swing: navigation links, FR/EN switch, 'Conférences interactives' expertise widget, white-paper and client-case resource widgets.
chrome.menu-overlay.scope: Overlay available from the header on the one homepage route.

chrome.seo-modal.description: Hidden dialog holding long-form SEO rich text, opened from a footer link.
chrome.seo-modal.scope: Mounted once on the homepage route, closed by default.

chrome.footer.description: footer#FOOTER: 'PRÊT À TRANSFORMER VOTRE IMPACT?' glass panel with cursor-following glow and label tooltips, FR/EN switch, office cities, navigation and legal links.
chrome.footer.scope: Closes the one homepage route, rendered outside main#MAIN.

hero.statement.description: 700lvh header: visually-hidden SEO title ('Les meilleures idées font l'avenir / Quand elles sont bien présentées' — visible version is 3D in the backdrop), fixed subtitle 'La boite à slides® : seule agence au monde certifiée ISO 9001…' that fades in mid-scroll, and the bottom-left video widget with Scroll badge. Position at 1440x900: y 0 → 6300.
hero.statement.scope: First section of the one homepage route.

story.tagline.description: 500lvh pinned block: large 'Notre agence PowerPoint amplifie le retentissement…' statement sliding in line by line on the left, small paragraph bottom-right, over the green backdrop and triangle 'fence'. Position at 1440x900: y 6300 → 10800.
story.tagline.scope: Second section of the homepage route.

proof.works.description: 'UN SEUL OUTIL, DES POSSIBILITÉS INFINIES' title plus 8 case-study cards (Safran, Adidas, Marriott, Lipton, Kronenbourg, Nissan, Viridien, Upciti) with staggered reveal and cursor-following image hover; the card grid forces the header to light. Position at 1440x900: y 10800 → 13822.

proof.method.description: 30s looping marquee of credentials ('DEPUIS 2002 ● ISO 9001 ● 5/5 NOTE GOOGLE AVIS ● +8 000 PROJETS ● 85% DE RÉACHAT ● MOS…') with character reveal, tagline/paragraph with parallax and a mask-revealed metrics list. Position at 1440x900: y 13918 → 15164.

offer.skills.description: 540lvh pinned block of 3 stacked skill items each sliding in and fading out, with a 'Voir nos réalisations' split button, over the cyan backdrop and triangle pinwheel. Position at 1440x900: y 15260 → 20120.

offer.expertises.description: 'NOS EXPERTISES' list of large labels (Présentations, Communication 360, Navigation app like, Séminaire VR, Solutions IA) at low opacity that light up and pop a photo at the right viewport edge on hover. Position at 1440x900: y ≈ 20570.

story.vr.description: 600lvh pinned 'DÉPASSEZ TOUTES LES LIMITES DE POWERPOINT' block: VR headset flies through the camera, near-black backdrop cut, sphere of project thumbnails the camera ends inside, curved white wipe out. Position at 1440x900: y ≈ 21173 → 26573.

offer.spotlight.description: 'TOUJOURS CARRÉS. JAMAIS FORMATÉS.' statement with a parallaxing image (+300 → −300px). Position at 1440x900: y ≈ 26573.

content.resources.description: 'NOS DERNIÈRES RESSOURCES' row of article, client-case and white-paper cards (white paper shown as a rotated mockup) that pop in once and reverse on scroll back. Position at 1440x900: y ≈ 27376.

proof.labels.description: 500lvh pinned 'ENGAGÉS POUR LA QUALITÉ' block: three glass label cards (5 étoiles Google Avis, Certifié ISO 9001:2015 Bureau Veritas, Microsoft Office Specialist) flying right-to-left on a curved path. Position at 1440x900: y ≈ 28290 → 32790.

proof.reviews.description: 'ILS NOUS FONT CONFIANCE' draggable slider of 7 client testimonials with momentum, edge resistance and prev/next buttons. Position at 1440x900: y ≈ 32966.

content.faq.description: 'DES QUESTIONS? ON VOUS RÉPOND' accordion (several questions can be open at once, as on the live site) of 16 questions (6 shown, +6 per 'Voir plus de questions') with cursor-bending string dividers and a scroll mask reveal. Position at 1440x900: y ≈ 33820.
content.faq.scope: Homepage route only, last section before the footer.
